n: Arduino Explore IoT Kit and Arduino Cloud for Schools ML in education
t: An Arduino Education article with IoT and machine learning project ideas for school.
steps: Read the Arduino Education article on the role of the IoT in education.
Decide whether a smart parking or healthy diet project fits your class.
Buy the Explore IoT Kit Rev2.
Ask IT to approve Arduino Cloud for school use.
Set up Arduino Cloud and connect the kit.
Test one sensor reading before planning the lesson.
Write a short project plan for students.
